title: Pure Gold Pride
summary: Gold Pride cards only, with generic staples. Every Gold Pride monster summons itself from the hand while your LP are lower than your opponent's, so the deck pays LP on purpose: The Crowd Goes Wild! and Better Luck Next Time! search a monster and cost LP equal to its ATK. The Extra Deck monsters use their effect and return to the Extra Deck in the End Phase, leaving a Main Deck monster behind. Gold Pride - Eliminator, the newest Main Deck card, banishes another Gold Pride to make a Gold Pride Token of its Level for Synchro Summons. Gold Pride - Eradicator destroys one or two Extra Deck monsters on the opponent's turn and brings Eliminator back in the End Phase. Gold Pride - Leon locks the Extra Deck to Gold Pride once its effect is used.
